prediction: Preregistered on current main: compare the Phase 3 defaults with one-key arms for herdDungTicks 450/1800, herdDungSize 40/100, herdDungZoneMax 15/45, herdSeedChance 0.25/1 and herdSeedMinDistance 400/1600 (16 seeds x 200000 ticks, policy live). Expect larger dung areas and higher seed chance to increase eval.dung_food_share and eval.herd_seeded_patches, while size/cap changes may alter patch-following; eval.herd_follow_share is watched as a held-patch comparison. Report grazing, population, predators, prey, families and food energy as balancing diagnostics. note: Completed on the preregistered current-main 828d638 config: all 11 arms, 16 seeds x 200000 ticks, policy live, with reports and table in evals/screens/results/herd-ecology/. Dung-food share >=0.03 passes in all arms and seeds (means 0.1121 to 0.1304). Seeded patches per 1000 ticks miss the 0.1 target in every seed and arm; means are 0.0095 to 0.0178, with positive-seed counts 9/16 to 12/16. Grazed share means are 0.4326 to 0.4811, above the 0.25 ceiling in all arms. The highest herd-follow watch mean is 4.193 at herdDungTicks 1800; that arm has predators at end on 0/16 versus 2/16 on the reference and basin_lineage_effective >=3 on 2/16 versus 5/16. Generic population gate is 0/16 in every arm; prey are present 16/16. These global deficits and the seed/grazing target misses are follow-ups, never claimed passes or adoption blockers under user direction. Preregistered matched 32-seed extension and reports are in evals/screens/herd-ecology-power.grid.json and evals/screens/results/herd-ecology-power/. At n=16, eval:power false-positive rates are 0.183 for eval.herd_follow_share (no detectable effect), 0.084 for eval.dung_food_share (80% power at a 30% relative change), and 0.089 for eval.herd_seeded_patches (no detectable effect). On 32 matched seeds, herdDungTicks 1800 moves follow-share 2.465 to 3.353 (95% CI -0.368 to +2.760), dung-food share 0.12393 to 0.12591 (CI -0.00883 to +0.01375), and seeded-patch rate 0.01266 to 0.01086 (CI -0.00724 to +0.00428); no new detector shows a supported improvement. Generic population gate remains 0/32 and basin_lineage_effective >=5 is 12/32 on the reference vs 4/32 at 1800. Keep the existing herdDungTicks 900 default; the evidence does not support adoption. The single 500-agent benchmark is 3.5667 ms/step. The locked five-run comparison to Phase 3 start 828d638 is 3.5415 to 3.5677 ms (+0.7%) at 500 agents; total-step budget passes, but environment@500w7680 (+28.4%) and merit@500w7680 (+7.6%) exceed the 5% phase threshold. All survival/population/family deficits and seed/grazing misses remain balancing follow-ups, never claimed passes.
